messages:
maria: FYI — SmallBiz Accelerator cohort asked for an accelerated onboard lane + 90d pin grace if we serve them with an INT8 quantized variant. Can we scope acceptance gates/sla and what the migration support looks like?
ben: quick Q — is the ask unconditional 90d or 90d only if they opt into our concierge migration credits?
ashley: they want 90d included in the sales term; sales already flagged it as a must-have for the pilot. We can pair with credits but that feels like a separate commercial concession.
lee: from research/runtime POV INT8 introduces edge regressions on some long-context generative cases. We can ship with a validation harness that checks the cohort's top-50 prompts for quality regressions < 2% LLM-f1 drop.
sara: sales note: most smallbiz pilots are cost-sensitive — they prefer cheaper quantized variants, but they also want no breakage. If we require a 50-sample benchmark pass before pin is granted, that's reasonable.
maria: proposal: acceptance gates = (1) perf bench (latency/cost) must hit target, (2) cohort-specific quality regression < 2% vs float baseline on top-50 prompts, (3) pin grace = 60d default, 90d if they accept concierge migration & 1x migration credit. Thoughts?
ben: operationally 60d is safe. For 90d we need auto-fallback policy in Console so we can decouple contract from runtime risk. Also need a rollback checklist for customers.
lee: +1 on harness. Suggest we run a head-to-head A/B on the first 7 days in production with continuous eval alerts. If drift detected > threshold, auto-fallback to float model.
ashley: comms/contract ask — legal needs explicit language. Draft snippet: 
```
If quantized variant is pinned for a grace period, Redwood will provide one migration credit and concierge migration support. Redwood reserves right to unpin for quality regressions with 48h notice and automated fallback.
```
maria: tagging @ops-bot — can we schedule a canary with auto-fallback and an alert to the customer success inbox?
ops-bot: deploy-schedule created: canary window 7d, monitor hooks: eval-alerts, cs-notify. Ticket INF-7821.
sara: sales will accept 60d + 1x migration credit, push for 90d only if customer signs addendum. I'll update deal desk.
ben: next action for eng: prototype auto-fallback + canary hooks, add per-tenant benchmark pipeline. Estimate 2 sprints.
maria: action items: 1) eng -> canary + fallback prototype (owner: ben) 2) research -> validation harness + pass criteria (owner: lee) 3) product ops -> contract snippet + comms (owner: ashley) 4) sales -> decide pin grace on deal (owner: sara). Meeting Friday to confirm approach. :calendar: 
lee: I'll post a short checklist (top-50 sample selection + regression test) before EOD Thurs.
ben: will spin up a staging canary next week and drop logs in #eng-runtime.
maria: thanks all — goal is to have a repeatable playbook for quantized-variant pinning for cost-sensitive cohorts. We can reuse for other accelerator lanes. :rocket:
